name: stopfakeclicks – Bot Blocker for Google Ads
author: stopfakeclicks

sections.description:
Bots and repeat clickers burn your Google Ads budget. stopfakeclicks spots them on your WooCommerce shop, then blocks them in Google Ads with IP exclusions added by a script you paste into your Google Ads account. No Google Ads login is shared and no API connection is needed.

This plugin:

  • adds the stopfakeclicks tag to your shop. The tag only reports visits that arrive from a Google ad, sets no cookies and loads after the page;
  • tells stopfakeclicks when a visitor from an ad adds to cart or buys, so real shoppers are never blocked.

You need a stopfakeclicks account (14-day free trial, then USD 9.99 a month). Your first 7 days are watch-only: suspicious sources are recorded, nothing is blocked.

External service

The plugin’s script (included in the plugin) sends visit events to the stopfakeclicks service at https://api.stopfakeclicks.com/c, only for visits that arrive from a Google ad: the click id, the page path, the visitor’s IP address and browser details, and add-to-cart and purchase events. This is how suspicious clicks are detected and real shoppers are recognised.
When you click Connect to stopfakeclicks in the settings, your browser opens https://api.stopfakeclicks.com/connect/wordpress with your site address, your WordPress admin return address and a one-time code. Nothing is sent before you click. After you sign in and confirm, you come back with your site key.

Terms: https://stopfakeclicks.com/terms – Privacy policy: https://stopfakeclicks.com/privacy

If you use a consent plugin that supports the WP Consent API, the visit is only remembered after statistics consent. You can also stop the script entirely with the stopfakeclicks_load_tag filter.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > stopfakeclicks and click Connect to stopfakeclicks. Sign in or start the free trial, confirm, and you come back with your site key filled in. (You can also paste the key from stopfakeclicks.com/dashboard/script.)
  3. Copy your Google Ads script from the dashboard, paste it in Google Ads (Tools > Bulk actions > Scripts), authorise it and set it to run hourly.
sections.faq:
Will it block my customers?

No. Anyone who adds to cart or buys is trusted for good, and phones on mobile networks (where one IP is shared by many people) are never blocked.

Does it slow my shop down?

The tag is one small script loaded asynchronously, after your page.

  • Connect button: sign in to stopfakeclicks or start the free trial and come back with your site key filled in. No copying and pasting.

1.0.2

1.0.1

1.0.0

  • First release.
